title: Pass0bLangResult
description: Pass 0b-lang: Step-level language extraction with lesson-level summary

steps.description: Language extraction per step, one per input step, in order

step_number.description: Step number matching the input step

group_number.description: Group number this step belongs to

attention_cues.description: Literal phrases where the teacher directs attention and perception — what to notice, feel, sense, listen for, imagine. Semicolon-separated. Write 'None' if absent.

effort_language.description: Literal phrases framing effort, ease, permission, constraint, negation. Semicolon-separated. Write 'None' if absent.

image_language.description: Literal metaphors, analogies, physical imagery, vivid descriptive language. Semicolon-separated. Write 'None' if absent.

explanatory_language.description: Literal cause-effect explanations, biomechanical reasoning, pedagogical transparency. Semicolon-separated. Write 'None' if absent.

distinctive_phrasing.description: Notable word choices specific to this teacher's voice that don't fit the above categories. Semicolon-separated. Write 'None' if absent.

summary.description: Lesson-level summary of the teacher's language patterns

speaker_principles.description: 3-7 principles of how this teacher uses language to connect to the student. Each names a pattern, gives an example, and explains the pedagogical purpose.

signature_vocabulary.description: Words or phrases distinctive to this teacher, each with brief context.

dominant_attention_mode.description: The primary way this teacher directs attention across the whole lesson.

effort_philosophy.description: 1-2 sentence summary of this teacher's relationship to effort, as expressed through language.

teaching_voice_summary.description: 3-5 sentence paragraph characterizing how this teacher uses language as a pedagogical tool. Written for a trainee teacher.
